# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | HARDCODE / hidden-input re-run | 38332, 39046, 51359, 30709, 3911, 5192 (+ generalization hardening for all) | Agent's final code is replayed unchanged on 2 hidden inputs (diff data & row counts); agent hardcodes values/ranges/counts from visible input 1 → passes 1 of 3, scores 0. Prompt never states this. | KNOWLEDGE | missing-rule (menu 4) + worked example (menu 5) + remove harmful "you are done when file exists" line, add ordered verify step |
| 2 | Formula-not-recalced → write literal | 47741, 53367 (+57232 partial) | Agent writes live formula (TEXTJOIN/WORKDAY, FILTER dynamic-array) esp. on "fix my formula" tasks; LibreOffice recalc leaves it blank → 0. | KNOWLEDGE | add WHY + narrowing rule naming the function classes (menu 2 & 8) |
| 3 | Date/time TYPE fidelity | 51958 | Wrote pre-formatted string `"09/08/21 10:06"`; expected native datetime → grader serial ≠ string (type mismatch). | KNOWLEDGE / output-contract | tighten contract (menu 8) |
| 4 | data_only read of formula cells | 57232 | Read input with formula cells as raw `"=E36"` text and copied it as a value. | KNOWLEDGE | add rule (menu 4), folded |
| 5 | Extra commentary in answer range | CF_11072 | Values all correct but agent added "bonus" explanatory text in E5/F5 (inside range, expected blank). | output-contract | tighten contract (menu 8) |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | missing-rule + worked example | prompt.md ("graded on THREE input files") + task_template.md (re-run note) | States the fact that code is re-run on 2 hidden inputs with different data/sizes; forbids hardcoding values, hardcoding data extents, and copying example tabs; tells agent to detect extent from the file. General class rule, no task specifics. | Yes — passing tasks pass all 3 already ⇒ already generalize; reinforcing changes no output |
| 1 | ordered procedure / remove harmful line | task_template.md steps 1-3 | Removed "once that file exists, you are done" (actively discouraged verification); replaced with inspect→solve→verify where verification (re-open, print answer cells, check type + dynamic-extent) is a required precondition of "done". | Yes — verification is a check; correct outputs stay unchanged |
| 2 | add WHY + narrowing rule | prompt.md ("Write final computed VALUES") | Explains LibreOffice recalc + names dynamic-array/volatile/AGGREGATE classes that don't recalc; requires literal value, esp. for "fix my formula" tasks. Does NOT ban simple formulas that recalc. | Yes — additive; passing tasks that used recalc-able formulas keep working; existing "prefer literals" strengthened not reversed |
| 3 | output contract | prompt.md ("Match the expected value AND type") | Date/time answers → native datetime/date/time + number_format (grader serial); numeric strings tolerated; no text sentinels in numeric ranges. Conditioned on "when the answer is a date/time value (not text)". | Yes — passing date tasks already write native datetimes (else they'd fail on type) |
| 4 | add rule (folded) | prompt.md (data_only line) | Read computed value of a formula input cell via a separate `data_only=True` copy; never copy `"=..."` text. Conditional/additive. | Yes — additive; passing task 44266 read raw data w/o data_only and is unaffected |
| 5 | output contract | prompt.md ("Touch only the answer cells") | Write only computed answer values; no explanatory text/labels/commentary; leave value-less cells blank. | Yes — passing sheet tasks fill cells that HAVE values; rule never blanks a needed cell |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- trace 38332/39046/51359/30709: agent used `range(2,6)`/hardcoded C-labels & passed only test 1 → re-run note + "detect extent, don't hardcode" would have made it read the actual rows/labels per input, matching inputs 2&3. Confirmed by comparing 3 answer files (labels/values differ per input).
- trace 3911: agent computed the correct greedy split then OVERWROTE it with a typed dict → "keep the computation, don't replace with the typed result" line targets this exact move.
- trace 47741: agent wrote `=TEXTJOIN(...WORKDAY...)`; expected B5 is literal string; TEXTJOIN/WORKDAY don't recalc → "evaluate the formula yourself, write the value" fixes it (function classes named).
- trace 53367: agent used dynamic-array FILTER → blank on recalc; literal-value rule + dynamic-array warning addresses recalc half.
- trace 51958: agent wrote string `"09/08/21 10:06"`; expected native `datetime(2021,8,9,10,6)`; contract line "write native datetime, not a string" fixes the type miss (verified expected cell type is datetime).
- trace 57232: `load_workbook` w/o data_only copied `"=E36"` text → data_only rule fixes value/type.
- trace CF_11072: computed cells correct, only E5/F5 "bonus" text wrong (expected blank) → "no commentary, leave value-less cells blank" fixes it (verified E5/F5 expected blank in all 3 answers).

## Process & features used
- Subagents: yes — 3 parallel read-only diagnosis subagents (general-purpose), each clustering a subset of the 26 failing traces against the actual expected-answer workbooks. I verified the grading mechanism directly: adapter.py (same code replayed on 3 inputs; LibreOffice recalc) and evaluation.py (data_only compare; numeric strings/int/float normalized to rounded float; datetime→serial; a written formula string stays a string → type-mismatch).
- Prior iterations: none (baseline only; LEDGER/RUNMAP empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The re-run / "compute don't hardcode" knowledge and the inspect→solve→verify ordering — the dominant lever on this benchmark.
- The literal-value + named-non-recalc-function-classes rule.
- Do NOT re-add "once the output file exists you are done" — it suppresses verification.

## Deliberately skipped (ambiguous / broken ground truth / infra — a prompt edit cannot recover these)
- 73-45: INFRASTRUCTURE — formula recalculation failed in grading (flagged in feedback). Not a prompt defect.
- 56996: expected values are cached RANDBETWEEN draws; LibreOffice re-rolls on recalc → no output can match (non-deterministic artifact).
- 59667, 59743: answer key contradicts the stated instruction ("if blank return blank" but key extrapolates; "difference" but key adds). Not derivable.
- 325-44: ground truth has non-derivable quirks (careType constant column, F2 = single space).
- 30709: ground-truth date parsing is self-inconsistent across rows (DD.MM.YY vs YY.MM.DD) — no single rule matches all 3 (the extent/hardcode fix still helps but the key itself is inconsistent).
- 56427, 57090, 50051, 55931, 110-2: underspecified or formula-anchored ground truth not derivable from the given instruction/inputs. (11842, 56637 borderline over/under-interpretation; not confidently prompt-fixable, left to the general "compute literally, don't over-transform" nudge.)
